describe.description: The creature is a quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of ground. It has the overall body, head, limbs and dense shaggy fur of a brown bear, with dark brown fur on the back and limbs and lighter tan fur on the muzzle, chest and belly. Covering its entire back from the shoulders to the rump is a large, highly glossy, domed dark brown to black shell resembling the elytra of a beetle, with longitudinal ridges, reflective highlights, and a row of small oval holes along its lower edge. A smaller glossy shield-like plate sits at the front of the shell over the shoulders. A single long, glossy black, sharply up-curved horn with a small tooth-like notch on its inner curve rises from the forehead between the ears.
